Visit 2 Scheduling Condition
data.description: Condition permitting Visit 2 to occur
data.text: Visit 2 may occur as soon as the criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed. At Visit 2, screening laboratory results will be reviewed to confirm eligibility.

data.name: Minimum Screening Duration Condition
data.description: Minimum interval required before randomization
data.text: Visit 3 (randomization) to occur no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1; screening period is up to 4 weeks (18-28 days).

data.name: Glycemic Eligibility Condition
data.description: HbA1c range required at screening
data.text: HbA1c ≥7.0% (53 mmol/mol) to ≤9.5% (80 mmol/mol) as determined by the central laboratory at Visit 1 (screening).

data.name: Antihyperglycemic Medication Naïve Condition
data.description: Prior medication restriction for eligibility
data.text: Naïve to insulin therapy except for gestational diabetes or ≤14 days use for acute treatment, and no oral or injectable antihyperglycemic medications during the 90 days preceding Visit 1 or between Visit 1 and Visit 3 (randomization).

data.name: Age / Consent Condition
data.description: Minimum age at informed consent
data.text: At least 18 years of age or the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction, whichever is older, at the time of signing informed consent.

data.name: Informed Consent Prior to Procedures
data.description: Condition required before any study procedures
data.text: The ICF must be signed before any tests or procedures are performed.

data.name: Fasting State Condition
data.description: Fasting requirement for fasting visits
data.text: Participants must report fasting after at least 8 hours without eating, drinking (except water), or significant physical activity, and must not take study intervention before the fasting visit. If a participant attends a fasting visit in the non-fasting state, reschedule the visit within the allowable visit interval.

data.name: Retinopathy Eligibility Confirmation Condition
data.description: Ophthalmologic eligibility based on fundus photography
data.text: Eligibility (exclusion criterion 13) MUST be confirmed based on fundus photographs and any additional ophthalmological evaluation needed at screening.

data.name: Baseline Retinopathy/DME Condition for Week 24 Imaging
data.description: Conditional performance of follow-up fundus photography
data.text: Follow-up fundus photography and additional ophthalmological evaluation are performed at Week 24 (±4 weeks) only if retinopathy or DME were present at baseline; all participants repeat imaging at Week 40 (-4 weeks to +2 weeks).

data.name: Hepatic Interruption/Discontinuation Laboratory Criteria
data.description: Laboratory thresholds for study drug interruption or discontinuation
data.text: ALT or AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L (whichever occurs first) and TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5.

data.name: Close Hepatic Monitoring Stabilization Condition
data.description: Condition allowing reduced monitoring frequency
data.text: Subsequently, the frequency of monitoring may be lowered to once every 1 to 2 weeks, if the participant's clinical condition and lab results stabilize.

data.name: Pregnancy Condition
data.description: Occurrence of pregnancy during the study
data.text: Any female participant who becomes pregnant while participating in the study will discontinue study intervention and will be withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Low BMI / Excessive Weight Reduction Condition
data.description: Trigger for dose modification and weight monitoring
data.text: BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction; monitor weight after dose reduction for BMI ≤20 kg/m2.

data.name: Poor Nutrition or Dehydration Condition
data.description: Trigger for management, dose modification, or discontinuation
data.text: Participants with or at risk of poor nutrition or dehydration may undergo dose modification or discontinuation per Section 6.6.2 and Appendix 11.

data.name: Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia Condition
data.description: Condition triggering rescue therapy
data.text: Rescue therapy for severe persistent hyperglycemia may be initiated per Section 6.9.4.

data.name: WOCBP Pregnancy Test Condition
data.description: Pregnancy testing conditions
data.text: Urine pregnancy test result must be available before the first dose of study intervention for WOCBP. Perform additional pregnancy tests if a menstrual period is missed, if there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy, or as required by local law or regulation.

data.name: Unscheduled Immunogenicity Sampling Condition
data.description: Condition requiring additional immunogenicity samples
data.text: Collect additional unscheduled samples if systemic drug hypersensitivity reactions (immediate or nonimmediate) or injection site reactions occur (severe or recurrent).

data.name: Contraceptive Use Restriction Condition
data.description: Restriction on injectable/implantable contraceptives
data.text: Use of subcutaneous/intramuscular or implantable/injectable contraceptives is prohibited except when initiated and used continuously for at least 18 months prior to study entry.

data.name: Safety Follow-up Visit Waiver Condition
data.description: Condition under which the safety follow-up visit is not required
data.text: Participants who have discontinued study intervention early and are only willing to come back for Visit 11 (Week 40) are not required to complete a safety follow-up visit if they have been off study intervention for at least 28 days.

data.name: Exceptional Circumstances Condition
data.description: Alternative conduct of the SoA
data.text: For participants whose participation is affected by exceptional circumstances, such as pandemics or natural disasters, refer to Section 10.14 for additional guidance.

data.name: Multi-Day Visit Condition
data.description: Condition allowing visit procedures across multiple days
data.text: Visit procedures may be conducted over more than 1 day if all activities are completed within the allowed visit tolerance period of each visit.

data.name: Pre-Dose Assessment Completion Condition
data.description: Sequence condition at randomization visit
data.text: All assessments should be completed before the administration of the first dose of study intervention; immunogenicity and PK samples for immunogenicity are collected before dosing; triplicate ECGs collected before all blood samples; vital signs taken before ECG tracing; AEs collected before PHQ-9 and C-SSRS.

data.name: DID-EQ Conditional Administration
data.description: Condition for administering DID-EQ at early discontinuation
data.text: DID-EQ is collected at the ED visit if discontinuation is at or before Week 4.

data.name: Concomitant Medication Review Condition
data.description: Ongoing assessment of background medications
data.text: Monitor closely and routinely assess the need to adjust or discontinue antihypertensive medications, diuretics, lipid-lowering agents, laxatives, and anti-emetics.

data.name: Screening (Visit 1) to Screening Laboratory Review (Visit 2)
data.text: Visit 2 may occur as soon as the criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed; screening laboratory results are reviewed at Visit 2 to confirm eligibility.

data.name: Screening to Treatment Period Transition (Randomization)
data.text: Confirm inclusion and exclusion criteria prior to randomization and administration of the first dose of study intervention at Visit 3; Visit 3 must occur no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1 (18-28 days). Randomization is performed via IWRS in a 1:1:1:1 ratio to retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, 12 mg, or placebo.

data.name: Treatment Period to Safety Follow-up Transition
data.text: A posttreatment safety follow-up visit (Visit 801) will occur approximately 4 weeks (±5 days) following the last treatment period visit (Visit 11, Week 40).

data.name: Hepatic Discontinuation/Interruption Rule
data.text: Study intervention is interrupted or discontinued if ALT or AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L (whichever occurs first) and TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5 (Sections 7.1.2 and 8.2.6.3).

data.name: Permanent Discontinuation from Study Intervention
data.text: Permanent discontinuation from study intervention per Section 7.1.1, including a discontinuation criterion for participants with poor nutrition or dehydration.

data.name: Temporary Interruption of Study Intervention
data.text: Temporary interruption of study intervention for gastrointestinal tolerability or for reasons unrelated to gastrointestinal tolerability (Sections 6.6.4 and 7.1.3).

data.name: Dose Modification via Blinded IWRS
data.text: All dose adjustments are managed in a blinded fashion through IWRS (Section 6.6).

data.name: Dose Reduction for BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or Excessive Weight Reduction
data.text: Dose reduction with subsequent weight monitoring is recommended for participants with BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction (Section 6.6.3).

data.name: Dose Modification for Poor Nutrition or Dehydration
data.text: Dose modification is an option for participants with or at risk of poor nutrition or dehydration (Sections 6.6 and 6.6.2; Appendix 11).

data.name: Rescue Therapy for Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.text: Rescue therapy/rescue medication may be initiated for severe persistent hyperglycemia (Sections 6.9.4 and 6.9.5); initiation of additional antihyperglycemic medication is an intercurrent event for the efficacy estimand and, where possible, fundus photography at Week 40 should be performed prior to the start of new antihyperglycemic medication.

data.name: Pregnancy-Related Discontinuation and Withdrawal
data.text: Any female participant who becomes pregnant while participating in the study will discontinue study intervention and will be withdrawn from the study (Section 8.3.2).

data.name: Early Discontinuation (ED) Visit Transition
data.text: For early discontinuation that occurs before the last visit in the treatment period, perform the activities listed for ED in the SoA.

data.name: Symptomatic Medication for Gastrointestinal Symptoms
data.text: Symptomatic medication may be given for gastrointestinal symptoms (Section 6.9.6).

data.name: Continued Access after End of Study
data.text: Continued access to study intervention after the end of the study per Section 6.7.

data.name: Participant Discontinuation/Withdrawal from the Study
data.description: Participant may discontinue/withdraw from the study at any time (Section 7.2); ED visit procedures are performed if discontinuation occurs before the last treatment period visit.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.description: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention (Section 7.1.1), including hepatic criteria (ALT/AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L with TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5) and poor nutrition/dehydration criterion; participants may remain in the study for follow-up.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: Participant lost to follow-up per Section 7.3.

data.name: Pregnancy Withdrawal
data.description: Female participants who become pregnant discontinue study intervention and are withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of the 40-week treatment period (through Visit 11, Week 40) and the 4-week safety follow-up period (Visit 801, approximately 4 weeks after the last treatment period visit), including eDiary return.

data.name: Safety Follow-up Waiver Exit
data.description: Participants who discontinued study intervention early and attend only Visit 11 (Week 40) exit without a safety follow-up visit if they have been off study intervention for at least 28 days.

data.name: Visit 1 Screening Eligibility Decision
data.description: Assessment of inclusion/exclusion criteria, central laboratory HbA1c, hepatitis screening, and fundus photography at Visit 1.

data.name: Visit 2 Laboratory Eligibility Confirmation Decision
data.description: Review of screening laboratory results and ophthalmological findings to confirm eligibility; Visit 2 may occur as soon as Visit 1 criteria are confirmed.

data.name: Visit 3 Randomization Decision
data.description: Confirm inclusion/exclusion criteria, confirm no antihyperglycemic medication use between Visit 1 and Visit 3, confirm negative pregnancy test for WOCBP, then randomize via IWRS (no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1) and administer first dose.

data.name: Week 4 Early Discontinuation PRO Decision
data.description: DID-EQ administered at ED visit only if discontinuation occurs at or before Week 4.

data.name: PK Sampling Window Assignment Decision (Weeks 7, 15, 19)
data.description: IWRS assigns each participant one PK sampling window (1-24 hr, 24-96 hr, or 120-168 hr post dose) at the PK-only visits at Weeks 7, 15, and 19.

data.name: Week 24 Retinopathy Follow-up Imaging Decision
data.description: Perform follow-up fundus photography at Week 24 (±4 weeks) only if retinopathy or DME were present at baseline.

data.name: Hepatic Monitoring and Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Decision to initiate close hepatic monitoring, reduce monitoring frequency to every 1-2 weeks upon stabilization, or interrupt/discontinue study intervention based on hepatic laboratory criteria.

data.name: Nutrition/Hydration and Low BMI Management Decision
data.description: Decision at each visit regarding dose modification, weight monitoring, or discontinuation for participants with poor nutrition, dehydration, BMI ≤20 kg/m2, or excessive weight reduction.

data.name: Glycemic Rescue Decision
data.description: Decision to initiate rescue therapy for severe persistent hyperglycemia; fundus photography at Week 40 preferably performed prior to start of new antihyperglycemic medication.

data.name: Concomitant Medication Intensity Evaluation Decision
data.description: Evaluation of antihypertensive and lipid-lowering medication treatment intensity changes from randomization at Weeks 12, 32, 40, and ED.

data.name: Safety Follow-up Requirement Decision
data.description: Determine whether Visit 801 safety follow-up is required based on whether the participant has been off study intervention for at least 28 days.
